definition_or_problem: two defined values are not equal
permitted_use: describe a reproducible numerical contrast with population, denominator, period, geography, and uncertainty
prohibited_shortcut: calling every difference a disparity or inequity

definition_or_problem: a measured difference in a health outcome or determinant across defined groups or places
permitted_use: use after the measure, comparison, reference, support, and uncertainty are accepted

definition_or_problem: a difference judged unfair or unjust using an explicit normative basis and relevant structural, historical, policy, and community evidence
permitted_use: use only with the additional evidence and accountable reasoning stated
required_evidence: technical evidence plus community and normative evidence
prohibited_shortcut: using inequity as a synonym for difference

definition_or_problem: often labels people or places instead of naming the material condition or exposure
permitted_use: state the specific measured condition, source, period, and consequence
prohibited_shortcut: vulnerable tract or vulnerable people as a fixed identity

definition_or_problem: can confuse an area estimate with an individual prediction or moral label
permitted_use: use only for a defined measure and unit when the course later accepts it
required_evidence: accepted measure and level of inference
prohibited_shortcut: high-risk resident because of tract data

definition_or_problem: requires evidence about service availability, access, use, quality, or need
permitted_use: state the specific service gap and evidence
prohibited_shortcut: inferring underserved status from SVI alone

definition_or_problem: a human and program judgment informed by evidence and community priorities
permitted_use: describe the evidence, capacity, local knowledge, and decision process
required_evidence: public evidence plus structured community review
prohibited_shortcut: equating a high rank with entitlement or need

definition_or_problem: a characteristic measured for a geographic unit
permitted_use: use at the same area level with source, vintage, uncertainty, and ecological limits
prohibited_shortcut: assigning the value to an individual resident

definition_or_problem: a deterministic fictional value built for instruction
permitted_use: label every use and keep it separate from public evidence
required_evidence: generator identity, seed, known truth, and checks
prohibited_shortcut: reporting it as a real Massachusetts outcome or community view
